items.name: Golden Turmeric Spiced Latte (Shahi Haldi Doodh)
items.description: Steamed creamy milk infused with organic turmeric, black pepper, green cardamom, and sweet wildflower honey.
items.history: The ancient Ayurvedic healing potion consumed across Indian homes for centuries before becoming a global health sensation.
items.howMade: Fresh turmeric root extract and black pepper are whisked with hot milk, green cardamom, and sweetened with raw honey.

items.name: South Indian Filter Kaapi (Degree Kaapi)
items.description: Traditional dark roast coffee with 15% chicory brewed in a brass filter, frothing with thick boiled milk in a brass Davarah-Tumbler.
items.history: Smuggled out of Yemen in the 17th century by Sufi saint Baba Budan in his beard and planted in the Chandragiri hills, evolving into South India's sacred morning newspaper ritual.
items.howMade: Coarsely ground Arabica and Robusta beans blended with chicory are slow-dripped through a stainless/brass Indian filter, hand-whipped with steaming full-fat milk from great heights ('meter tea pour') to create thick silky froth.

items.name: Ginger Elaichi Kadak Chai
items.description: Robust spiced milk tea simmered with extra pounded fresh ginger root and green cardamom.
items.history: The wake-up companion of million news readers across Delhi and Bombay, specially brewed extra 'Kadak' (strong) to stimulate morning alertness.
items.howMade: Crushed fresh ginger and green cardamom are boiled vigorously with robust tea leaves until the decoction turns rich mahogany, blended with hot milk and cane sugar.

items.name: Paneer Tikka
items.description: Cottage cheese cubes marinated in spiced yogurt and grilled in a clay oven with bell peppers and onions.
items.origin: Punjab & Royal Mughal Kitchens, Northern India
items.history: Invented during the Mughal era in the 17th century as a royal vegetarian alternative to meat kebabs, later popularized in Punjab using live babool charcoal tandoors.
items.howMade: Fresh malai paneer cubes are marinated in cold-pressed mustard oil, hung curd, ajwain, degi mirch, and kasuri methi for 4 hours, then skewered with crunchy peppers and roasted at 480°C in an earthen clay tandoor.

items.name: Crispy Veg Spring Rolls
items.description: Golden rolls packed with shredded crunchy garden vegetables and glass noodles with hot garlic dip.
items.history: Born in Kolkata's historic Tangra Chinatown in the 1950s where Hakka Chinese settlers infused Indian aromatics into traditional Cantonese spring rolls.
items.howMade: Shredded cabbage, carrots, bell peppers, and scallions are wok-tossed with light soy and white pepper, rolled into thin pastry skins, and fried to golden perfection.

items.name: Bhatti Da Murgh
items.description: Rustic highway dhaba style charcoal-roasted chicken infused with crushed black pepper and cloves.
items.history: Cooked over open cast-iron coal pits ('Bhatti') along the Grand Trunk Road, known for its dark spice rub and intense smokiness.
items.howMade: Chicken is rubbed with hand-pounded black peppercorns, cloves, mace, cinnamon, and burnt mustard oil, roasted on iron grates over white embers.
